anyOf.description: Whether the rule evaluates. A disabled rule is kept but never fires.
Whether the rule evaluates. A disabled rule is kept but never fires.

enabled.description: Whether the rule evaluates. A disabled rule is kept but never fires. Only for operation create, set_enabled; required for operation set_enabled.

maxAffected.description: Preview only: how many affected transactions to sample, at most 25. affectedCount in the result equals this sample size; check candidateCount for the true total match count.

name.description: Human-readable rule name, shown in the rules list. Only for operation create, update; required for operation create.

operation.description: create: Create a new rule, or preview creating one (preview: true). update: Change the name, conditions, or actions of an existing rule, or preview the change (preview: true). Provide at least one of name, conditions, action. set_enabled: Turn an existing rule on or off without changing it, or preview the change (preview: true). reorder: Set the evaluation order of every rule in the portfolio, or preview it (preview: true). delete: Remove one saved rule from active use, or preview removing it (preview: true). current: Preview the saved rules as they stand, changing nothing.

orderedRuleRefs.description: Every rule handle in the portfolio, in the order they should evaluate. Rules apply in order, so earlier rules win. Only for operation reorder; required for each.

portfolioRef.description: Portfolio name or slug inside that workspace. Call list_portfolios to resolve it.

preview.description: When true, evaluate the change and return its impact without saving it. Not for operation current.

ruleRef.description: Saved rule handle, from list_accounting_rules. Only for operation update, set_enabled, delete; required for each.

workspaceRef.description: Workspace name or slug. Call list_workspaces to resolve it.
